text:
maria: Quick thread to coordinate the customer follow-up for this morning's outage. I'm drafting the external message and status page text — need sign-off on tone, impact numbers, and SLA/credit language. Incident affected inference API endpoints; partial degradation, not data loss.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260412-47 triggered at 2026-04-12T09:14:21Z. Pages sent to @sam and @eng-sre. Severity: Sev2.

sam: Oncall here. Mitigation completed at ~2026-04-12T09:52Z by temporarily routing traffic to the warm fallback pool and rolling back a deployment planner change. Root cause preliminary: autoscaler + planner race condition that left several GPU nodes under-provisioned for short high-concurrency window. Digging into logs now.

lena: For CS: which customers saw errors vs latency? I pulled metric snippets — 502s spiked for 38m, p95 latency doubled for 26m. We should be conservative in customer impact wording.

jordan: AE check: top customers we proactively reached out to — Acme Corp (reported errors), Rivel Labs (errors + retries), Parkwell (elevated latency but no failed requests). I can confirm account contacts and whether they need a personalized note.

maria: Thank you. Draft external email below — please comment inline. My goals: concise apology, clear impact window, what we did, next steps + offer of credit, link to public status and PM.

--- DRAFT EMAIL ---
maria: Subject: Update on this morning's Redwood inference service disruption

Hi <Customer>,

We're sorry for the interruption to the Redwood inference API this morning (2026-04-12). Between 09:14Z and 09:52Z some requests experienced increased errors (502) or elevated latency.

What happened: a deployment planner change combined with autoscaler timing led to a temporary under-provisioning of CPU/GPU capacity for certain request patterns, causing partial service degradation.

What we did: we rerouted traffic to a warm fallback pool, rolled back the planner change, and increased autoscaler safeguards to prevent recurrence.

Impact: A subset of requests saw 502 errors (peak error rate ~7% on affected routes) and higher latency; there was no data loss or unauthorized access.

Next steps: we will publish a short postmortem with timeline and long-term mitigations by 2026-04-16 and follow up with a private RCA for enterprise customers where requested.

Compensation: we will apply a one-time credit equivalent to 10% of the charges for the hour of impact to affected accounts. If you prefer a different remedy, reply to this message and we'll handle it directly.

Again, we're sorry for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

Best,
Maria (Customer Success)
--- END DRAFT ---

aaron: Tone looks good. Two suggestions: (1) don't put the exact percentage number in the public status page — keep it in the customer email only, (2) tighten "postmortem by" date to "by 2026-04-15 EOD" if engineering can commit.

sam: Technical clarifications for the private RCA: the planner change was a change to the placement heuristic that reduced excess capacity headroom during scale-up. The autoscaler cooldown window was too short in the code path that handles bursty short-lived requests. Proposed mitigations: bump cooldown to 60s, add circuit-breaker that falls back to warm pool if scale-up hasn't completed within 30s, and add canary gating for planner changes.

ops-bot: Reference alerts: alert/502-spike-INC-20260412-47, metric-slice: inference.api.*.error_rate (09:10Z-10:00Z). Logs sample: `2026-04-12T09:18:33Z ERROR handler.go:142 request_id=abc123 code=502 upstream_err=connection_reset`

lena: Two practical asks for the email: 1) include a direct contact line for impacted customers to request an enterprise RCA, 2) link to the status page entry (private link for enterprise in the meantime).

maria: Updated draft for public status page and an enterprise email template below. Keep the public status blunter, enterprise email mirrors the draft but adds technical appendix and contact.

--- PUBLIC STATUS PAGE SNIPPET ---
We experienced a partial disruption to inference API between 09:14Z and 09:52Z. Some requests returned errors, and latency for others increased. We routed traffic to fallback capacity and reverted a recent deployment change. No customer data was exposed. A postmortem will be published when available.
--- END SNIPPET ---

--- ENTERPRISE EMAIL TEMPLATE ---
Hi <Customer>,

We wanted to provide more detail on the incident affecting the Redwood inference API on 2026-04-12. Below is a short timeline and planned next steps. If you'd like a private, technical RCA with logs and mitigations, reply and we'll prioritize it.

Timeline (UTC):
- 09:14:21 incident triggered (error spike observed)
- 09:18 mitigation attempts (partial fallback routing)
- 09:28 identified planner change as likely contributor
- 09:36 initiated rollback of planner change
- 09:52 full service routing to warm pool restored

We will follow up with a private RCA and proposed permanent changes (cooldown adjustments, canary gating) by 2026-04-15 EOD.

Contact: maria@redwood.ai or +1-555-0102 for enterprise follow-up.
--- END TEMPLATE ---

jordan: For impacted accounts we should mention the credit offer and offer to schedule a technical call. I'll add the AE contacts for Acme and Rivel.

maria: SLA credit language proposal (short): "We will apply a one-time service credit equivalent to 10% of your billed charges for the hour of impact. To request an alternate remedy or private RCA, reply to this message or contact your account team." Thoughts?

aaron: OK for CS email. For public status page be more generic: "a subset of requests saw increased errors and latency" and save numeric details for customers.

sam: Engineering sign-off: we can commit to the interim mitigations (cooldown/circuit-breaker) within 72h, and the full canary + planner rollback QA in 2 weeks. I will include ticket IDs in the postmortem. Also recommend adding an automated alert that tracks planner-operations + autoscaler readiness as a composite SLI.

deploy-bot: Deployment rollback of planner v3.4 -> v3.3 completed at 2026-04-12T09:36:47Z (job 9321).

lena: CS ops: I'll compile the affected-customer list and flag enterprise accounts that need private RCAs. Expect that by 12:00Z.

maria: Perfect. Requesting final sign-off: public status snippet (aaron), customer email template (jordan + lena), SLA credit text (aaron), and engineering commitments (sam). Please react or reply by 16:00Z — I'll plan to send the public status update and targeted customer emails at 17:00Z if no blockers.

sam: Signed off on engineering commitments.

aaron: Signed off on tone + credit language for CS email. Leave out the 7% number public.

jordan: Signed off for outreach to Acme + Rivel. Will personalize subject lines.

lena: Signed off on lists and contact points.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260412-47 marked resolved at 2026-04-12T10:00:12Z. Postmortem path: /incidents/INC-20260412-47/postmortem (internal).

maria: Thanks everyone — sending the messages now and will post the internal postmortem link when the doc is ready. I'll also track follow-ups (private RCAs and applied credits) and report back in this thread. :heart:
